views.markdown: People have dreamed of running macOS on iPad for more than a decade. Today, that dream comes true. With Virtual Mac, iPad finally breaks free from iPadOS, enabling pro apps like Xcode, Terminal, Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, and Pixelmator Pro to run directly on device. Requires iPad Pro (M1, M2) or iPad Air (M1) running iPadOS 14 up to 16.3.1, or iPhone 14 Pro and iPhone 14 Pro Max running iOS 16 up to 16.3.1.

views.title: Compatibility
views.text: iPadOS 14 up to iPadOS 16.3.1, iOS 16 up to 16.3.1

views.markdown:
Virtual Mac on iPad 1.2.3 adds momentum scrolling when using Magic Keyboard, fixes graphics issues with Firefox, and defaults to larger storage size when creating Virtual Mac.

### Input
- Adds momentum scrolling when using Magic Keyboard for iPad
- Adds the ability to interrupt momentum scrolling with a light tap

### Graphics
- Fixes graphics issues with Firefox

### Creation
- Defaults to larger storage size for newly created Virtual Mac when iPad has sufficient remaining storage space
- Adds informative text about storage being non-resizable after creating Virtual Mac
Virtual Mac on iPad 1.2.2 improves stability when creating a new Virtual Mac.

Virtual Mac on iPad 1.2.1 improves scrolling performance and system stability.

### Input
- Improves scrolling speed, acceleration, and responsiveness when using a mouse, trackpad, or touchscreen (LemomQ)
- Delivers coalesced Apple Pencil samples at up to 240 Hz for improved responsiveness (ma-syu)
- Adds an option to hide the mouse cursor when using the touchscreen

### Stability
- Fixes graphics issues with Sublime Text and Sublime Merge
- Fixes black screen when launching Intel-based apps using Rosetta on iPadOS 14
- Fixes boot failure when Video Encoding and Decoding Acceleration is enabled on iPadOS 14

### Design
- Adds informative text about recommended processor core count and memory allocation
- Reduces text truncation when using Virtual Mac in Slide Over, Split View, and Stage Manager
- Improves user interface on supported iPhone 14 Pro and iPhone 14 Pro Max models running iOS 16 up to 16.3.1

Virtual Mac on iPad 1.2 adds support for Final Cut Pro, improves compatibility with Metal games, introduces OpenGL and OpenCL acceleration, and improves system stability.

### Pro Apps
- Adds support for pro video apps like Final Cut Pro in Virtual Mac
- Quickly download the latest compatible version of Xcode, Final Cut Pro Trial, Logic Pro Trial, and Pixelmator Pro Trial from the menu bar

### Graphics
- Adds support for Mac games like Skate Story and 7 Days to Die
- Fixes pink graphics in Metal games by introducing native support for BC texture pixel formats
- Press ctrl+↑, then drag game window out of Mission Control for better performance in windowed mode
- Introduces support for OpenGL and OpenCL acceleration which improves performance in apps like Chess and Preview
- Easily toggle OpenGL and OpenCL acceleration from the menu bar for apps incompatible with runtime library injection such as Hopper Disassembler
- If you’d like to add support for another game, point Codex or Claude Code to the Virtual Mac repo and iterate together, then open a pull request

### Stability
- Fixes network connectivity issues on iPadOS 14
- Reduces system freezes when Virtual Mac is under heavy graphics load
- Fixes Geekbench Metal benchmark on iPad Pro models with 16 GB of RAM (iPad Pro with 8 GB RAM have insufficient VRAM)

### Input
- Adds experimental, opt-in support for Apple Pencil pressure and tilt (requires separate download for pencil-probe by @ma-syu)

Virtual Mac on iPad 1.1.2 improves network reliability and external display support, and contains bug fixes:

### Network Reliability
- Prevents Virtual Mac networking services from being terminated under memory pressure

### External Display
- Adds Full Screen Mirroring for external displays (qwqVictor)
- Adds display resolution presets for the active window, external display, 1080p, 4K, 5K, and 6K
- Fixes reversed scroll directions when using Virtual Mac on an external display with Stage Manager

### Touch and Diagnostics
- Adds a scrolling speed setting for two-finger touchscreen scrolling
- Quickly access and adjust Virtual Mac settings from the more menu
- Warns users when running Virtual Mac in an unsupported roothide environment

Virtual Mac on iPad 1.1.1 improves the problem reporting experience and contains bug fixes:

- Redesigned problem reporting experience guide users to create a screen recording, save diagnostics, and create an issue on Github
- Automatically detect and fix keyboard related crashes
- Fixes Move Controls checkmark placement in HUD menu

Virtual Mac on iPad 1.1 introduces support for iPadOS 14 and iPadOS 15, improves touch and keyboard input, adds localization across 37 languages, and includes design and reliability improvements.

### Compatibility
- Introduces support for iPadOS 14 and iPadOS 15
- Raises the configurable memory limit for Virtual Mac (jamesy0ung)

### Touch
- Scroll through macOS with two fingers
- Perform a secondary click by tapping with two fingers
- Double tapping a file or folder opens it more reliably in Finder
- Fixes an issue where tapping a menu item doesn't perform the selected action
- Perform a secondary click with an optional touch and hold gesture in Settings

### Keyboard
- Use the globe (fn) key for page up, page down, home, end, forward delete, and keypad enter shortcuts (qwqVictor)
- Adds adjustable control overlay opacity, including a fully transparent option that remains tappable
- Adds an optional Keyboard Crash Workaround for iPadOS 16.2
- Prevents the SpringBoard keyboard and gesture hook from crashing into Safe Mode (qwqVictor)
- Improves Mac keyboard shortcut forwarding across tweak loaders (qwqVictor)

### Installation
- Resolves installer launch failure by automatically repairing traverse only permission required on /var/root (Mohabreda)
- Detects and temporarily stops conflicting usbmuxd processes during installation (kok3shidoll)
- Automatically creates a compatible configuration manifest when importing a Virtual Mac bundle
- Improves alerts for DFU and usbmuxd conflicts, low storage failures, and other installation failures

### Design and Localization
- Adds localization for 37 languages
- Streamlines the New Virtual Mac screen to easily choose between the recommended release and other macOS versions
- Shows each Virtual Mac's storage capacity in grid and list view
- Adds an optional Portrait Full Screen resolution setting

### Reliability
- Adds Export Diagnostics, which produces a ZIP archive with app and restore logs for troubleshooting
- Adds an optional Recover Networking After Sleep setting to restore ethernet connectivity after sleep or backgrounding
Virtual Mac on iPad 1.0 is the initial release.
